privacy_and_integrity.history_validation: For each actual fetched history, retain exact framed protobuf event bytes from the source helper; independently parse framing and protobufs, recompute byte SHA-256 and compare the source observation. A list/query summary is never a substitute for raw history.
privacy_and_integrity.json_validation: Every JSON artifact must be strict JSON; gate stores its actual file SHA-256, verifies owned regular file and mode 0600 under an owned mode-0700 directory. For common owner snapshots, recompute snapshot_sha256 over canonical snapshot bytes and preserve pytest node/phase/caller/time fields.
privacy_and_integrity.location: Only under the run-private IFPMIC_H2_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE_ROOT, with case roots and observation directories mode 0700 and files mode 0600; fixture-cleanup log remains in its exact runner-private root.
privacy_and_integrity.owner_observation_minimum: For every actual normal._read_owner_snapshot/crash.read_owner_snapshot invocation reachable in a literal test path, require exactly one persisted record containing the unmodified returned SQL rows, SHA-256, pytest node/phase, caller and monotonic timestamp. Count equals actual calls; variable polling loops have no static count. This applies only when the private root is enabled and helper returns successfully.
privacy_and_integrity.public_artifact_policy: Do not copy raw SQL rows, Temporal protobuf history, workspace marker/token bytes, auth/role data, PID/start ticks, logs, manifests, or credentials to public docs/evidence or git.
privacy_and_integrity.query_observation_envelope: Common h2_snapshot_evidence records actual operation, subject, result, pytest_current_test including phase suffix, monotonic time and caller; no expected fixed count for polling/read helper calls.
privacy_and_integrity.query_validation: For each required operation, retain the actual result argument to record_query_observation. Verify the serialized observation fields (kind, operation, subject, result, node phase, monotonic time, caller) and record file SHA-256 in the private gate; do not assume that the helper embeds a result hash.
privacy_and_integrity.serialization: Preserve actual returned SQL rows and decoded SDK observations without synthesizing or normalizing values; raw history must retain deterministic event bytes length-prefixed as source helpers do; each JSON evidence item must be parseable and hash/checkable against its actual bytes.

raw_evidence_minima.query_observations: For every operation in minimum_query_observations, preserve at least that many actual recorder files; recorder includes decoded actual result, subject, caller, pytest node, monotonic time, and private 0600 mode under 0700 root.

purpose: Per-literal-case mapping of raw private proof for the 83 full-ledger additions and four retained SQL/auth-only FENCES controls. This contract defines private artifacts and is not a runner gate or pass claim.
retained_scope_note: The NEG-PROJECTION-FENCES group is represented by exactly four supplemental retained literal IDs in this contract; its 407 retained base IDs are unchanged and remain in the full frozen inventory. The fifth supplemental retained control in the historical index is the existing normal CLI positive control and is outside these 87 raw-proof mappings.
unresolved_mapping_ambiguities: Polling loops emit one private record per actual invocation; exact dynamic file count is intentionally not predicted statically. Runtime verification must compare retained record counts against actual invocation/caller sequence where journaled.
For APIs that return no run, raw history is inapplicable; this does not prove server history is absent outside the exact observed namespace/workflow query.
Static source-derived counts and artifact paths do not establish runtime execution, permissions, file creation, or passing assertions.
